The interior minister told the National Assembly that the Registre national de la population grew from 3.4 million registered citizens in 2019 to over 5.1 million, with enrolment now a permanent public service.
A magistrates' club official refers to civil-status facts recorded in the population register, which the national population register and secure documents agency runs.

The government procedures portal (last updated 2023-11-21) describes a standing procedure to enrol a child born to Mauritanian parents in the population register (national biometric register) run by the ANRPTS, free of charge at citizen reception centres.
